title: init silently orphans existing issue files when index.json is missing
description:
'pebbles init' decides "already initialized" solely from .pebbles/index.json existing (Storage::exists() in src/storage.rs). If the index is gone but issue files remain, init writes a fresh empty index and reports success, which silently disconnects every issue from the tracker.

Measured on pebbles 1.0.0 (build of this repo's HEAD), .no_jj store with 3 issues: 'rm .pebbles/index.json' -> 'pebbles list' fails with "Pebbles not initialized"; 'pebbles init' -> exit 0, '✓ Pebbles initialized successfully'; 'pebbles list' -> 'No issues found.' while all 3 issue files are still under .pebbles/issues/. No warning, no confirmation prompt, and no command to rebuild the index (see 0f6f1445 doctor, todo). Same trap is one 'jj restore' or a bad conflict resolution away during a merge of index.json (measured in b931c524).

Ask: make init inspect issues/ before writing an index. If issue files exist with no index, refuse unless --force, and offer the rebuild-from-files path (that rebuild is also the repair half of 0f6f1445). Add a SPEC rule so the empty-store and lost-index cases are distinguishable.
